redaction_policy.rule: Sanitization retains full architecture, methodology, execution, acceptance, correction, and comparison prose while replacing personal roots, private target identities/locations, target-specific finding/artifact identifiers, digests, and concrete private finding descriptions with deterministic typed placeholders.
redaction_policy.per_source_counts: Every SANITIZED source inventory row records each applied rule and exact count in the published port.
redaction_policy.validation: Port hashes bind the published bytes; original hashes bind bytes held outside Git.
redaction_policy.deterministic_identifier_rule: Within the six privacy-interleaved core sources, identifiers are normalized by class and numeric value, ordinal-sorted across the six-source set, and assigned stable class-specific NNN placeholders; repeated source identifiers therefore retain join identity without disclosing raw IDs.

historical_revision_policy.backend_routing: The R2.5.6 GREEN-preparation package is the latest analyzed design package, but its production bindings were intentionally RED and its interim source manifest was non-evidence pending final source freeze. Earlier routing revisions remain historical, not concurrent authority.
historical_revision_policy.runbundle: R10B corrects one R10A field claim; R10B plus R10A plus the original R10 handoff form the successor collateral set, while the exact R10 freeze remains the implementation boundary.
historical_revision_policy.architecture: The original SQLite-first physical design is retired; semantic invariants survive through the typed-sidecar/PhaseIO architecture.
historical_revision_policy.missing_artifacts: The July claim that seven canonical paths were absent is superseded by current presence. Presence does not close semantic acceptance.

excluded_from_public_branch.reason: Reproducible from source or machine-specific; not source authority
Avoid binary duplication; retain reviewed source and provenance instead

privacy_scan.scope: All 127 published research ports after deterministic redaction
privacy_scan.limitation: Pattern scans are not a proof of absence; private/raw gaps must follow the separate transfer policy.

completion_claim.reason: Four raw payloads (two superseded ZIPs, one private audit report, and one private target postmortem) require hash-verified transfer outside Git; all goal-relevant semantics are portable.
